name: Wire Twilio Grok Voice
tagline_zh: 外呼脚本、双向音频桥、来电人设三件事一次配齐，不用自己啃 Twilio 的 WebSocket 分帧和 Grok …
tagline_en: Outbound dialing, a two-way Media Streams bridge, and caller persona in one setup — no hand-rolling Twilio.
desc_en: Use when connecting Twilio outbound voice to xAI Grok Voice for a Grok Bot or agent, including Media Streams bridge setup and caller-bot persona.
why_zh: 把 Twilio 的 μ-law 8k 音频和 Grok Voice 的流式接口在中间层对齐。
why_en: Aligns Twilio's 8k μ-law audio with Grok Voice's streaming API in a middle layer, with persona prompts kept separate so tone.
limit_zh: 只走 Twilio 外呼这一条路，来电接听和 SIP 中继都没覆盖；账号要备好 Twilio 号码。
limit_en: Outbound Twilio only — no inbound or SIP trunking. Needs a Twilio number, xAI API key, and a public WebSocket endpoint (tunnel for local dev).
title_en: Twilio outbound calls bridged to xAI Grok Voice
